title: 7Cav - Roster Patches
description: Companion add-on that patches behavioural gaps in NF/Rosters through class extensions, without modifying the vendor add-on. Fixes so far: a position's group grants are re-applied to its current holders when the position's group list is edited; and award and service-record dates are stored and shown as fixed calendar days, so the day a staffer enters is the day every viewer sees whatever their timezone.
